import os
import google.cloud.documentai_v1 as documentai

def extract_invoice_fields(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    project_id = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    location = "us"  # Or your preferred region, e.g., "eu"
    processor_id = config.get("processor_id", "YOUR_PROCESSOR_ID")  # Replace with your actual processor ID for invoices

    # Initialize Document AI client
    documentai_client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()

    # The full resource name of the processor
    # e.g., projects/project_id/locations/location/processors/processor_id
    processor_name = documentai_client.processor_path(project_id, location, processor_id)

    # Read the file into memory
    # 'payload' is expected to be bytes of the document (e.g., PDF, JPG)
    document = documentai.RawDocument(content=payload, mime_type="application/pdf") # Assuming PDF, adjust mime_type if needed

    # Configure the process request
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=processor_name, raw_document=document)

    # Process the document
    response = documentai_client.process_document(request=request)

    # Parse the response
    document_proto = response.document

    # Initialize fields to extract
    extracted_data = {
        "vendor": None,
        "date": None,
        "total": None,
        "line_items": []
    }

    # Helper function to get text from a text anchor
    def get_text_from_span(text_segments, text):
        if not text_segments:
            return None
        # Assuming the first segment is relevant for simplicity
        start_index = text_segments[0].start_index
        end_index = text_segments[0].end_index
        return text[start_index:end_index]

    # Extract entities
    for entity in document_proto.entities:
        entity_type = entity.type_
        entity_value = get_text_from_span(entity.text_anchor.text_segments, document_proto.text)

        if entity_type == "vendor_name":
            extracted_data["vendor"] = entity_value
        elif entity_type == "invoice_date":
            extracted_data["date"] = entity_value
        elif entity_type == "total_amount":
            # total_amount entities often have a "currency" and "value" property
            # For simplicity, just get the raw text here, but more robust parsing would use entity.properties
            extracted_data["total"] = entity_value
        elif entity_type == "line_item":
            line_item_data = {}
            for prop in entity.properties:
                prop_value = get_text_from_span(prop.text_anchor.text_segments, document_proto.text)
                if prop.type_ == "description":
                    line_item_data["description"] = prop_value
                elif prop.type_ == "amount":
                    line_item_data["amount"] = prop_value
                elif prop.type_ == "quantity":
                    line_item_data["quantity"] = prop_value
                # Add other line item sub-fields as needed
            if line_item_data:
                extracted_data["line_items"].append(line_item_data)

    result = extracted_data
    return result
